user.title: TELUS SmartHome+
user.description: Sign in with your TELUS SmartHome+ email and password (the same ones you use in the app).

data.auth_domain: Auth domain (leave as 'telus' unless told otherwise)
data.bridge_url: KVS camera bridge URL (optional, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8787)

error.invalid_auth: Login failed — check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the TELUS service. Check connectivity and try again.

init.title: TELUS SmartHome+ options
init.description: Bridge URL enables live video. Auto-save keeps copies of new recorded clips in your Home Assistant media folder (media/telus_clips).

data.auto_save_clips: Auto-save new recorded clips to HA media (uses disk space)
data.keep_days: Delete saved clips older than this many days (0 = keep forever)
data.save_folder: Save folder for clips (blank = HA media/telus_clips). E.g. /media/nas/cameras

error.cannot_write: Home Assistant can't write to that folder. Check the path and that the share is mounted.

download_clip.name: Download clip
download_clip.description: Save a TELUS recorded clip as MP4 in the HA media folder.

clip_id.name: Clip ID
clip_id.description: Clip id; defaults to the newest clip.

folder.name: Save folder
folder.description: Folder to save into (default: the folder set in options).
